article_context: Body image for the #2 attraction, “Hammer of Fate.” It supports the article’s emphasis on a giant swinging platform that rushes down after a moment of weightlessness, keeping the riders’ adrenaline and suspense central.

The seated group is visibly excited, with raised arms and legs; the long turquoise ride arm and the car are the main moving structure.
The wide view shows the ride’s downward-facing direction and the surrounding ruined-building set.
